title: Traxler Counterattack
author: LlamaChess Repertoire
description: The Traxler Counterattack: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.Ng5 Bc5! — twenty-six wild lines punishing the Fried Liver with sacrificial chaos.
